title: The Dark Money Behind AI Doomer Panic
content:
Why does everyone suddenly think AI could kill humanity? In this week’s episode of Power User, I’m joined by Washington Post tech journalist Natasha Tiku to discuss the now extremely viral claim that AI has a 10% chance of causing human extinction.

Researchers at Anthropic and OpenAI continue to push this idea, and we uncover how the insular, billionaire-funded Effective Altruism (EA) movement transformed sci-fi doomsday theories into mainstream media panic and undemocratic policy proposals.

We break down the math behind the so-called “10% extinction risk,” expose how dark money and ideological fellowships shaped mainstream AI coverage, and discuss why big tech labs actively benefit when lawmakers regulate frontier models out of fear rather than tackling immediate, real-world harms like wage discrimination, data privacy violations, and corporate consolidation.
